SSO GAP (confirmed live 2026-09-12, not yet fixed — facilitator-launch mitigation only this round, full fix deferred): AutoRevive has no platform-SSO integration at all. `.env.prod` only defines its own local JWT scheme (ALGORITHM=HS256, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS) — no PLATFORM_VERIFY_SESSION_URL/SIM_API_KEY like ZeroToPMF has. `frontend/app/page.tsx`'s RootPage does an unconditional `redirect("/dashboard")`, dropping cohort_id/sim_id/role before anything can read them. `frontend/app/(simulation)/sessions/new/page.tsx` then checks `localStorage.getItem("ar_access_token")` and bounces to `/login` when absent — confirmed live via 403s on POST /api/v1/simulation/sessions and GET /api/v1/auth/me in autorevive-api-1 logs. Required fix (not built): preserve cohort_id/sim_id/role through the root route (same shape as ZeroToPMF's StratagemGate, which gates at `/` instead of redirecting blindly), install @usamarasheed26/sdk, call Stratagem.init(), and exchange the platform session for a local AutoRevive token (or allow guest/cohort sessions in sessions/new that bypass the local username/password gate for platform-launched cohorts). Root frontend serves via an internal nginx container (app_autorevive). Redirects to a login route by design (307). .env.prod is box-only.
